rationale: A is more useful because it compares all three live options across the key decision dimensions and explains why hybrid dominates while naming the conditions under which that could change. Its recommendation is also more operational: self-serve routine work, centralize ambiguous/cross-cutting questions, maintain a rulings log, and define triage criteria. B is solid and somewhat more concrete on cadence and staffing ratios, but it gives less discriminative analysis of when alternatives might be preferable and handles uncertainty more narrowly. Neither provides strong quantitative support, though B includes one small threshold example.
